title: More third declension — nouns and adjectives; -ο- contracts; contracted futures

paradigms.label: γένος — Third Declension (neuter σ-stem)
paradigms.notes: Stem γενεσ-: the σ drops between vowels and the vowels contract (γένε(σ)ος → γένους, γένε(σ)α → γένη).

paradigms.label: δηλόω — Present Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: ο-contract: ο + ε/ο/ου → ου, ο + ει/ῃ → οι, ο + ω → ω. The οι forms are the exam trap.

paradigms.label: πόλις — Third Declension (ι-stem)
paradigms.notes: The stem alternates ι/ε: πόλι- in nom/acc singular, πόλε- elsewhere. The genitive πόλεως keeps its accent by quantitative metathesis — accusative plural borrows the nominative.

paradigms.label: πῆχυς — Third Declension (υ-stem)
paradigms.notes: Declines like πόλις with υ for ι in the nominative/accusative singular.

paradigms.label: ἱππεύς — Third Declension (ευ-stem)
paradigms.notes: The ευ diphthong survives only before a consonant (ἱππεύς, ἱππεῦσι); before a vowel it breaks to ε. Nominative plural ἱππῆς is the older Attic — later texts write ἱππεῖς.

paradigms.label: ἀληθής — true (singular)
paradigms.notes: Masculine and feminine share one column. The σ of the stem contracts with every ending: ἀληθε(σ)-ος → ἀληθοῦς.

paradigms.label: ἀληθής — true (plural)
paradigms.notes: ἀληθῆ is the neuter plural here and the masc/fem accusative singular in the other table — one spelling, three grammatical lives.

paradigms.label: ἀληθής — true (dual)
paradigms.notes: One dual form serves all genders — and ἀληθεῖ doubles as the dative singular.

paradigms.label: σώφρων — prudent (singular)
paradigms.notes: Declines like δαίμων: long ω in the nominative masculine/feminine, short ο everywhere else. The vocative σῶφρον retracts the accent.

paradigms.label: σώφρων — prudent (dual)
paradigms.notes: One dual form serves all genders.

paradigms.label: βαλῶ — Future of βάλλω (contracted)
paradigms.notes: Liquid stems lose σ in the future and contract instead: βαλέ-ω → βαλῶ. Looks like a present of ποιέω — only context and the stem tell you it is future.

paradigms.label: ἐλῶ — Future of ἐλαύνω (contracted)
paradigms.notes: The future of ἐλαύνω contracts like a present of τιμάω: ἐλά-ω → ἐλῶ.

paradigms.label: δηλόω — Present M/P Indicative
paradigms.notes: ο-contraction throughout: δηλό-ομαι → δηλοῦμαι; the 2nd singular δηλοῖ is spelled exactly like the active 3rd singular.
